reads.stopped_at: The programme gives you a closer look at what the workshop involves, so you can decide whether hand building is something you’d like to explore.
reads.what_it_sells: A beginner, instructor-led weekend pottery workshop where I would try shaping provided clay by hand and later collect the fired pieces.
reads.relevance_feedback: The profile explicitly says I am a local adult interested in trying a creative weekend activity, and the email offers a beginner creative weekend workshop, so the premise fits. The email additionally assumes I might be interested specifically in hand-building pottery; that preference, along with my availability, budget and ability to reach the venue, is unknown.
assumed_experiences: Profile-supported: I am interested in trying a creative weekend activity.
Email-only: hand-building pottery may appeal to me.
Email-only: I can attend on the workshop's unspecified weekend date and collect the fired pieces later.
Email-only: I am close enough to the unspecified venue for attendance and later collection to be practical.
reads.problem_now: There is no pressing problem to solve. This is an optional leisure activity that broadly fits my stated interest, but the email establishes no particular timing or reason to consider it this morning.
reads.biggest_doubt: I cannot judge whether the workshop is practical because the email gives no price, location, date, duration or collection timeframe.
reads.to_click_it_would_have_to: I would have clicked if this email had told me the price, location, next available date and workshop duration.
fixes: Rewrite “ClayRoom’s beginner pottery workshop is a chance to try hand building with clay during a creative weekend activity.” to include the next date, location, duration and price.

Cut “The programme gives you a closer look at what the workshop involves, so you can decide whether hand building is something you’d like to explore.” because it repeats the preceding explanation without adding a useful fact.
Rewrite “After the workshop, the pieces are fired and collected when finished.” to state how long firing usually takes and where collection happens.
Rewrite “View the workshop programme →” as “See dates, price, location and the workshop programme →” so I know what the click will answer.
